summary: Build spreadsheet-based supply chain optimization skills for transport, inventory, and planning decisions. Explore the five-day course and curriculum.
lede: Supply chain optimization modeling uses defined objectives, constraints, and operational data to compare feasible planning choices. Designed for supply chain planners, logistics analysts, inventory planners, and operations managers new to optimization, this foundation-level course teaches you to prepare and validate inputs, formulate linear programming problems, and build small Excel Solver models for allocation, transportation, and inventory scenarios. You also practise interpreting trade-offs and documenting assumptions and limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use supply, logistics, inventory, or operational data to evaluate planning choices. It suits learners new to mathematical optimization who can work with basic spreadsheets.
prerequisites: Basic spreadsheet skills, including entering data and using formulas, are recommended. No previous optimization modeling or programming experience is required; coding is not required for course completion.
